channel.title: ASIScan — notes on agent security
channel.description: Static analysis for AI agent codebases, mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, the OWASP LLM Top 10, and EU AI Act Article 50.

item.title: ASI05: when your agent builds a shell command out of model output
item.description: A real exec() call built from model output, why input validation misses it, the fix, and how ASIScan's rules catch it.

item.title: The OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, explained for engineers
item.description: The OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, walked category by category: what each one looks like in code and what static analysis can and can't see.

item.title: ASI09: the approval dialog your agent wrote for itself
item.description: If a model composes the text of your confirmation prompt, the human is approving a description, not an action. How that gap opens and how to close it.
